name: Know Your Customer Check Type 1 Code
definition: Specifies the type of Know Your Customer (KYC) or anti-money laundering due diligence to which the investor has been subjected.

ENHA.name: Enhanced
ENHA.definition: Enhanced check, typically carried out on accounts that are considered high risk.

ORDN.name: Ordinary
ORDN.definition: Ordinary check, typically carried out on standard accounts.

SIMP.name: Simple
SIMP.definition: Simple check, typically carried out on accounts that have a low risk of anti-money laundering, such as an account owned by a financial institution.
